name: Dimension Engine Showcase
summary: Explore GPU-powered digital twins, live process maps and factory training in Ignition.
description:
Explore an automotive digital twin with robotic production cells, an aligned process atlas, equipment panels and incident replay. Move from the production floor into a credited Gaussian room capture with utility trends and simulated operating signals.

The complete local development showcase now runs inside an **Ignition Perspective project**, hosted by the native Dimension Engine module. Automotive, Gaussian Studio, facility and process maps, water and steel plants, GPU experiments, and **Super Maintenance Bros.** share one application. Native HMI dashboards open within the Perspective session.

### Play Super Maintenance Bros.

Run, jump and restart a procedural factory. Cross conveyors, power the lift and restore the line, or choose a guided run. The native project connects the game to isolated synthetic Gateway tags and an operations dashboard.

The free hosted browser preview uses synthetic or reference data and has no plant or Gateway connection. Gallery screenshots show the native development project; the hosted preview may differ. The native module builds locally as an unsigned development installer; a signed public download is not offered yet. Ignition licensing remains separate.

The engine-room capture is **Tugboat Bat, Trieste, by tosolini**, captured with XGRIDS PortalCam and used under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). [Original capture](https://superspl.at/scene/1a14e1e7). Equipment relationships and operating signals are authored, simulated overlays.
cost_notes: The hosted browser preview is free to use for evaluation and learning, with no account or time limit. It uses synthetic or reference data and has no Gateway save or plant connection. The complete local development showcase runs inside Perspective using the native Dimension Engine module. It requires Ignition Perspective trial time or a license. The unsigned module is built locally; no public installer is offered yet.

faq.question: Does the hosted preview connect to a plant?
faq.answer: No. The browser preview uses synthetic or reference data. No plant or Ignition Gateway is connected.

faq.question: Can I download a native Ignition module?
faq.answer: A native module now builds and runs locally with the complete showcase in a Perspective project, including Super Maintenance Bros. It is still an unsigned development preview; a signed public installer is not offered yet.

faq.question: What is Super Maintenance Bros.?
faq.answer: A 2D platformer in a procedural 3D factory. Cross conveyors, power the lift, dodge presses and restore the line. Try “Watch a shift” for a guided run, or use WASD, Space and E to play. Includes cinematic camera movement, GPU effects, quiet sound and a hideable FPS counter. “Behind the game” explains its rendering and state. The separate local Ignition edition connects to synthetic Gateway tags and a native Perspective dashboard.

name: FUXA
summary: Build web-based dashboards and process visualizations for your machines.
description: A web-based SCADA and HMI editor with support for industrial protocols including MQTT, Modbus and OPC UA. This listing covers the free open-source edition.
cost_notes: The open-source edition is free to self-host. Optional paid Pro features are outside this listing. Hardware and hosting are your own.

name: Eclipse Mosquitto
summary: A lightweight MQTT broker for connecting devices and applications.
description: Run a publish-subscribe messaging broker on your own infrastructure. Mosquitto implements MQTT and includes command-line clients for publishing and subscribing to topics.
cost_notes: Free to download and self-host. Hardware, network access and any external hosting are supplied separately.

name: MQTT Explorer
summary: See your MQTT topics, inspect messages and understand your data.
description: A desktop MQTT client that organizes topics as a tree. Explore payloads and topic activity when developing or troubleshooting a messaging system.
cost_notes: Free desktop client. Connect to your own MQTT broker. The upstream license restricts redistribution of modified versions; review its terms.

name: Node-RED
summary: Connect devices, APIs and services with visual, event-driven flows.
description: Build flows in a browser-based editor and run them on your own machine or server. A useful starting point for moving industrial data between systems and prototyping integrations.
cost_notes: The self-hosted software is free. You provide the computer or hosting; optional third-party services may have their own costs.
